sections.bio:
Passionate, skilled Technical Support and Networking professional with a B.Sc. in Computer Science, CCNA certification and over 3 years of hands on experience in switching and routing protocols. I bring a strong foundation in network infrastructure and hardware troubleshooting.
​I have received specialized computer networking and troubleshooting education from APtech, equipping me with advanced technical techniques. My experience is unique in its breadth spanning from international importation and warehousing of high value IT equipment to hands on deployment and configuration. I understand the entire lifecycle of a network, from the moment the hardware lands in the country to the moment it goes live.
​Currently, I am contributing to global AI and data infrastructure projects, including high level Egocentric Data Annotation for cutting edge vision models. This work has sharpened my ability to deliver high quality technical results in a fast paced, remote and asynchronous environment.
​I am open to new opportunities in Network Engineering, IT Support and Technical Operations where I can drive results for forward thinking international and local teams

posts.text:
Everyone scrutinizes MTN, but why is no one talking about Airtel Nigeria ?
​The way field technicians and installers under AirtelFiber are treated is unacceptable. Basic salaries are low, welfare is terrible, and workers are expected to haul heavy ladders and tools to customer locations out of their own meager pockets with zero transport allowance.
​Hiding behind third-party outsourcing companies doesn't shield Airtel from responsibility for how Nigerian workers are treated on their network.
​I call on PTECSSAN . and relevant labor authorities to audit Airtel Nigeria's labor practices and hold them accountable!
​#AirtelNigeria #WorkersWelfare #M #TelecomsNG #PTECSSAN #FairWages
